unreadable.deniedBody: It is outside the range you were granted. Pick another from the list, or ask the system administrator for the range if you need this one.
unreadable.absentBody: Nothing is stored at that address. It was deleted, or the address is wrong. Pick another from the list.
unreadable.failedBody: The server did not answer. Try again shortly, and tell a system administrator if it keeps happening.
